modes.local: validated local receipt and complete canonical reports or full coverage fallback
modes.candidate: validated read-only successful-main receipt and reports or no heavyweight PR recomputation
modes.release: validated receipt and reports or blocking full coverage fallback

digests: canonical production source inventory and contents
product and tooling test inventory and contents
coverage scope, thresholds, configuration, and owner implementation
every canonical JSON, LCOV, and HTML report file
proof: Only successfully validated full product coverage may write the receipt; every blocking consumer recomputes all input and report digests.
rollback: Delete the disposable receipt or omit its read-only CI mounts to force full coverage.
collisionCheck: Receipt and reports are materialized atomically only under canonical disposable paths.
